items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: we used to have periodical meetings, he and I, which was no more than a social thing.

ctx.x: Yeah. But was that just by some quirk of assignment, here, you, Stan, take the solo for Early Autumn, or did you really feel that --
No, when he wrote it as Early Autumn, he wrote it for Stan.
Oh, he had him in mind.
